title: Sloe Berry Borscht Crumble
description: A twist on the classic Eastern European beet-based soup, this recipe incorporates the sweet flavors of sloe berries for a refreshing dessert. Serve warm with a crumbly topping.
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine sloe berries, beets, and borscht. Cook over medium heat until the mixture is heated through.
Stir in sugar and lemon juice.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix crumbly pastry and vegan butter until crumbly.
Top the borscht mixture with the crumbly pastry mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown.
